LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedText: The people of {OLD} ({NAMES}) have lived a day at {PLACE} now, and their council and the colony's council here are one.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedTraditions: Their traditions join the colony's here: {TRADITIONS}. One only they kept counts at half its strength, and lapses as any tradition does unless the colony keeps it.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedElection: They are a third or more of the grown-ups here now, so the council is chosen again this season, with their say.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedNames: The names they were known by at {OLD} are looked at again in the next naming; where both colonies had someone known by one, the better keeps it.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedDay: The founding day of {OLD} is kept here as a day to remember while some of its people live here.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedMeal: On the first evening the colony sits down to a meal together to welcome them, and its speaker greets them as the cups go up.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedGreeting: The colony's speaker has a word of welcome for them.
LanguageData.CC_Many_MergedHistory: The people of {OLD} came to live at {PLACE}, and the two councils became one.
LanguageData.CC_Many_WelcomeLabel: the welcome for the people of {OLD}
LanguageData.CC_Many_WelcomeCause: the welcome for the people of {OLD}
LanguageData.CC_Many_NameKept: {PAWN} keeps the name {TITLE} at {PLACE}, where {OTHER} was known by it too.
LanguageData.CC_Many_ScopeColonyTip: This page shows the people of {PLACE}, the colony in view, and what is theirs. Click to see everyone from every colony.
LanguageData.CC_Many_ScopeEveryoneTip: This page shows everyone from every colony. Click to see only the people of {PLACE}, the colony in view.
LanguageData.CC_Many_WeekColoniesTip: Where it stands, as the colony's card says. Click to see the colonies on the region map.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ManyMerge_Tip: When a colony's home is given up or handed over and its people come to live at another home that has people and a council of its own, once they have lived a day there the two councils become one: the traditions only they kept join the colony's at half their strength (one both kept keeps the stronger), the council is chosen again within the season when they are a third or more of the grown-ups, the names they were known by are looked at again in the next naming (the better keeps one both had, and no rival comes of a name taken over in the first season), their old colony's founding day is kept as a day to remember while some of them live there, and on the first evening the colony sits down to a meal together to welcome them. Off: a moving officer still steps down and the old council is kept thirty days, and nothing more.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_ManyMerge: A colony's people who come to live at another home bring their traditions and their names, and are welcomed at a meal.
